title: Aspire Biopharma Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Aspire Biopharma Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 16, 2026 reporting outcomes of a Special Meeting of Stockholders held April 10, 2026. Stockholders approved five proposals: a reverse stock split (1-for-5 to 1-for-500 ratio), issuance of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock conversion shares, an equity line of credit agreement with Arena Business Solutions Global SPC II, Ltd., an increase in authorized common stock from 490 million to 700 million shares, and a potential adjournment proposal. This is a micro-cap biotech corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Special Meeting held April 10, 2026 approved reverse stock split at ratios from 1-for-5 to 1-for-500 (2,096,356 for, 582,185 against)
Series A Preferred Issuance Proposal approved (1,466,141 for, 203,756 against) for conversion shares exceeding 19.99% threshold
ELOC Agreement with Arena Business Solutions Global SPC II, Ltd. approved (1,469,985 for, 203,926 against)
Authorized common stock increase from 490,000,000 to 700,000,000 shares approved (1,925,368 for, 524,501 against)
Company is an emerging growth company listed on Nasdaq under symbols ASBP and ASBPW
